name: code_flow
description: Find process flows (entry -> steps -> exit) matching a name or endpoints. Prefer this over manually tracing call chains across files -- the flows are pre-indexed. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder is missing or is not a git repository.
